Introduction
This document out line the inspection check list
(I1-Y1) for START UP system mark II GE. No. IC 3600 SSKC (1L-1R)
The first draft prepared by eng Sawsan El_Lethy, on 16/8/2003, and tested by eng Waeltaha. the document field

Safety Precautions
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
A work 
 permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
